quarantined_leads.source_title: Oklahoma police officer and wife arrested on elderly exploitation charges
quarantined_leads.reason: The report, citing an Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation release, says McVicker was arrested in Enid on August 29, booked on complaints of exploitation of an elderly person and conspiracy, and placed on administrative leave pending the investigation. The subject has a covered law-enforcement role, but the accessible official and reputable reporting does not document a Republican, conservative, right-wing, Trump-administration, or qualifying affiliated-organizational role. The complaints remain unresolved and no guilt is inferred; the lead is quarantined under the affiliation gate.

coverage_gaps: North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska, Kansas, Oklahoma, Texas, Colorado, New Mexico, and Arizona state-level attorney-general, ethics, court, public-safety, corrections, licensing, and election-integrity indexes were checked. No additional in-window person-specific event meeting the timing, covered-role, and explicit-affiliation rules was identified.

The Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation newsroom is a dynamic index and did not expose the specific August 29 release as a directly crawlable article; the accessible Oklahoman report and search extract identified the release and its procedural details, but the lead was not publishable because qualifying affiliation was not documented.

Several state and county law-enforcement, court, ethics, licensing, and municipal pages are dynamic, fragmented, incomplete, or not uniformly time-filtered; blocked or erroring pages were treated as coverage gaps rather than evidence of absence.

The Oklahoma prison call-center investigation was reviewed and remains outside this run's new-lead set because it was already quarantined in the August 30 A09 artifact; it identifies an agency/program practice but no responsible qualifying official.

Older or out-of-window matters involving Angel Cisneros, Danny Williams, Johnny Rodriguez, Keith Bell, Kell Palguta, and other previously reviewed subjects were checked for duplication and were not re-emitted.

Routine private-person bookings, policy disputes, campaign messaging, and criminal matters involving people without a covered public role or documented qualifying affiliation were excluded; the negative result is not evidence that no other misconduct occurred.
